trust_center.repositoryDescription: FedRAMP Trust Center for the TrustGuard AI Compliance Platform. PUBLISHED LIVE: public tier open unauthenticated; reviewer tier request-only behind a server-side NDA gate with .gov/.mil auto-approve and access logging.
trust_center.accessRequestInstructions: The Trust Center landing page and this Certification Package Overview are open and require no authentication or access request. Certification data in the reviewer tier (Security Decision Record, KSI validation reports, Minimum Assessment Scope, Secure Configuration Guide, Ongoing Certification Reports, VER/IEC/SCN reports, architecture and program documents, and supporting evidence) is released to necessary parties on request. To request access, open https://app-gov.trustguardai.com/trust-center/tguard-ai and use the "Request Access" action, supplying your name, organization, government email address, and the purpose of the request; acceptance of a non-disclosure agreement is required. Requests from .gov and .mil email domains, and from the engaged FedRAMP-Recognized 3PAO (a-lign.com), are auto-approved and receive an emailed access link, typically within minutes. All other requests are reviewed by the TrustGuard AI security team within one business day. All access grants and document downloads are logged. For assistance, or if a request is denied, contact security-inbox@trustguardai.com.

secure_configuration_guidance.repositoryDescription: Secure Configuration Guide (SCG) for the TrustGuard AI Compliance Platform, published in the Trust Center reviewer tier as 'Secure Configuration Guide (SCG)' (human-readable) and 'Secure Configuration Guide — Machine-Readable' (JSON). Covers customer-configurable security settings, hardening baselines, the cryptographic module register (CMU-CSO-CMD; FIPS-validated / CMVP-validated module inventory per CMU-CSO-UVM), and the customer responsibility matrix.
secure_configuration_guidance.accessRequestInstructions: Open https://app-gov.trustguardai.com/trust-center/tguard-ai and use the "Request Access" action with your name, organization, government email address and purpose. Requests from .gov and .mil domains and from the engaged FedRAMP-Recognized 3PAO (a-lign.com) are auto-approved and receive an emailed access link, typically within minutes; .gov/.mil requesters are exempt from the NDA gate. Once granted, open the Trust Center and download 'Secure Configuration Guide (SCG)'. How to USE the guide: apply the hardening baselines to your tenant configuration, then use the customer responsibility matrix to confirm which controls you own versus which TrustGuard operates. Questions: security-inbox@trustguardai.com.

current.service_desc: TrustGuard AI is a comprehensive, AI-native Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) platform that unifies internal compliance automation and external threat monitoring in a single system of record. Inside the organization, TrustGuard AI continuously collects evidence, maps it to recognized control frameworks — including FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST 800-53, NIST CSF, HIPAA, PCI DSS, and CMMC — and uses retrieval-augmented AI to assess controls, surface gaps, draft remediations, and generate audit-ready, machine-readable findings and reports. Looking outward, it delivers continuous third-party and supply-chain risk monitoring, scoring vendors and partners against real-world security signals so teams can quantify exposure, prioritize outreach, and track remediation across their entire ecosystem. By combining automated internal compliance with external security ratings and attack-surface intelligence, TrustGuard AI gives security, risk, and compliance leaders one continuously-updated view of their posture — from their own controls to every vendor they depend on. The platform is offered as SaaS. The provider maintains a SOC 2 Type 2 program, and its FedRAMP 20x Moderate (Class C) independent verification and validation assessment was COMPLETED on 2026-10-09 by A-LIGN, a FedRAMP-Recognized independent assessment service, with all 203 applicable FedRAMP requirements (157 provider FRRs + 46 Key Security Indicators) determined MET; the FedRAMP authorization decision and FedRAMP-assigned Certification ID remain outstanding as FedRAMP outputs. The FedRAMP-assessed instance operates in production within AWS GovCloud (US). The provider's legal entity name is TGuardAI Inc.; A-LIGN's assessment letter refers to the same entity by its trade name "TrustGuard AI Inc."
